metadata.case_name: LUK KA WAI v. LEE YUK CHUN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Moderate degree of deep burns (scald) affecting multiple areas: Lower part of chin; Front of chest; Medial aspect of right forearm; Medial aspect of left arm; Area between the proximal and distal phalanges of the middle three fingers of left arm; Dorsal aspect of the proximal phalangeal area of left ring and middle fingers; Lateral aspect of the base of left thumb; Front of left thigh; Right side of buttock; Medial part of right thigh.
injuries.body_part: lower part of chin; front of chest; right forearm (medial); left arm (medial); middle three fingers of left hand; dorsal proximal phalangeal area of left ring and middle fingers; base of left thumb (lateral); front of left thigh; right buttock; medial right thigh
source: (5) Area between the proximal and distal phalanges of the middle three fingers of left arm
(6) Dorsal aspect of the proximal phalangeal area of left ring and middle fingers
(7) Lateral aspect of the base of left thumb
She was found to have a moderate degree of deep burns

manifestations.description: Considerable pain and suffering at the time of the accident and for a long time afterwards; cried continuously for several days and thereafter periodically; cried loudly after debridement operations.

Varying degrees of scarring in the skin due to the scald, including congested raised areas, congested scarring, pale scarring, circumferential pale scarring and hypertrophic (keloid) scars as recorded by Dr. Lee.

Hypertrophic scarring (keloids) likely to be established and likely to give great distress to the child and the parents; treatment of the residual scars is not likely to be satisfactory; keloid scarring might improve or could get worse; might cause pain; corrective plastic surgery would be difficult.
Possible impediment to development of the left breast due to site of scarring; "the site of scarring could possibly impede development of the left breast."

Psychological upset, inhibition, embarrassment and reduced confidence as she matures; restricted to non-revealing clothing in a mainly tropical climate; "will feel ill at ease to wear bikinis and short pants ... may severely undermine her confidence in herself."
Physical discomfort from chaffing of the scars; exposure to sun would cause the scars to be more unsightly.
Change in temperament after injury: "hot-tempered compared with her previously calm nature."

treatments_received: Several painful debridement treatments in the operating theatre
treatments_future: Possible skin graft over left breast to relieve contracture (plastic surgery, if required)

losses.description: Residual claw-like scarring and prominent keloid scars on parts of her body particularly important to a female causing considerable inhibition, embarrassment and sorrow as she matures; unsightly scars over the left chest and right thigh.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Will feel ill at ease to wear bikinis and short pants; may severely undermine her confidence in herself; restriction to non-revealing clothing.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tang Lo Lai-chun v. Yim Ho Wai-lin and anor.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Large number of injuries with large areas of unsightly scar tissue and wastage of flesh on left arm; could be partially remedied by plastic surgery.

comparable_cases.case_name: L.M. Sabidussi by her next friend v. The Mother Superior of the Soeurs de Saint Paul de Chartres (Hong Kong) & anor.
comparable_cases.injury_description: Girl of 5 received an electrical burn on her right leg resulting in conspicuous, unsightly and discoloured scar measuring 48 mm x 32 mm; skin thin and may ulcerate easily; advised to delay skin graft until teenage years.
Very bad burns to a girl aged about 5 years; full skin burning over one-fifth of the area of her body; life in grave danger; extensive burns and scars.
